subcategory_text: Data are destroyed according to policy.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: MP-6 (Media Sanitization), SR-12 (Component Disposal)
implementation_examples: Destroy data according to documented policy, with destruction methods commensurate to data sensitivity (logical erasure, cryptographic erasure, physical destruction of media)
Maintain destruction records (asset, method, date, technician, witness) for accountability
Include backups and off-site media in the scope of destruction
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data destruction follows documented policy
Determine whether the destruction method is commensurate with data sensitivity
Determine whether destruction records are maintained
Determine whether destruction covers backups and off-site media
